column1: # Major OB/GYN guideline rules on missed/late oral-contraceptive doses
# model represents and reproduces each. Used for the manuscript Guideline-Concordance table.
#  FSRH-CHC-2023  = FSRH Clinical Guideline: Combined Hormonal Contraception
#  FSRH-POP-2022  = FSRH Clinical Guideline: Progestogen-only Pills
#  CDC-SPR-2024   = CDC U.S. Selected Practice Recommendations for Contraceptive Use
#                   Recommended Actions After Late or Missed Combined Oral Contraceptives.

column2: Traditional levonorgestrel/norethisterone POP: backup if >3 h late
column4: LNGP grace_h = 3 h; low margin, sub-maximal Emax
column5: ~48% perfect-use ovulation; least forgiving; forgiveness undefined on ovulation surrogate

column2: Desogestrel POP: backup if >12 h late
column4: ETG grace_h = 12 h; comfortable perfect-use margin
column5: reliably suppresses ovulation at perfect use; tolerates ~0 consecutive missed

column2: Drospirenone-only pill: backup if >24 h late
column4: DRSPP (Slynd, 4 mg): drospirenone disposition, long t1/2, grace_h = 24 h
column5: reliably inhibits ovulation at perfect use; the most forgiving POP

column2: Missed 1 active pill: take it, no extra precaution, no EC
column5: escape <=5% at 1 missed for both COC

column2: Missed >=2 active pills: take recent pill, backup 7 days
7-day rule: need 7 consecutive active pills; extended hormone-free interval is the key risk
column4: missed pills at pack start lengthen the hormone-free interval
column5: extended-HFI escape rises 1.7%->17.2% over 0->4 missed start pills

column2: Pills missed adjacent to the hormone-free interval are riskiest
column5: start-of-pack the most fragile on the escape-probability curves

column2: Forgiveness order: COC > desogestrel-POP > traditional LNG-POP
column5: LNG/DRSP COC (2) > drospirenone-/desogestrel-POP (0; drospirenone-only most forgiving by lateness) > LNG-POP (undefined)

column2: Emergency contraception if >7 consecutive COC pills missed in a week
column4: n_missed up to 7 in the escape grid
